objective: Deliver a working LLM-driven iterative artifact editor (React + HTMX) — create → display → edit again via natural language → re-display across turns → save to local library — driven by typed AG-UI-style streaming chunks and an editor state machine.
type: design-heavy feature build (not a bug patch)

branch_policy.notes: Per CLAUDE.md, build on the 1.9.x line; never use v2.

core_finding.summary: The iterative LLM artifact editor does not exist yet. Current artifacts feature = create-via-chat + display/preview + MANUAL code edit + library CRUD. There is no artifact code-patch protocol, no editor state machine, and no typed artifact stream events. The 'broken patch protocol' is really an absent feature to be designed on top of solid existing primitives.
exists: display cards/popups (CodeBlockView/*) incl. ArtifactPopup manual editor
typed AG-UI substrate (apiServer/protocols/canonicalEvents.ts, agUiMapper.ts, RuntimeAgentStream, AgentStreamInterface) — reusable spine
missing: artifact CODE patch protocol (only ArtifactMetadataPatch = metadata)
editor state machine for the multi-turn create->edit->preview loop
build/validate-in-the-loop feedback to the next LLM turn
artifact-specific typed stream event kinds on CanonicalAgentEvent

decisions.edit_transport: full-file rewrite per turn first; base-anchored diffs are a later optimization
decisions.edit_engine_and_loop: chat model via structured output/tool, renderer-orchestrated loop; typed AG-UI-style events modeled on top (NOT a dedicated agent-runtime session for v1)

open_questions_resolved.artifact_shape: single-file (tsx/jsx for React, one .html for HTMX); multi-file project tree deferred
open_questions_resolved.designer_surface: extend ArtifactPopup into a 3-pane designer (chat|code|preview) behind mode='designer'; no new window in v1
open_questions_resolved.event_channel: renderer-local typed channel + reducer; kinds mirror CanonicalAgentEvent so later AG-UI promotion is mechanical; no main-process changes in v1
